text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy put on a run that hinted at 
her future potential. She got cocky, 
expecting a storm of interviews, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With barely any attention and only a tiny 
mention in a magazine, a frustrated girl 
tries to enter a major race. 
However—something feels wrong with her 
leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The legs of an Umamusume who has only just 
entered her growth phase are delicate. 
Placing excessive strain on them now could 
cause periostitis, leaving her unable to 
run with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided not to push her 
legs too hard for a while, letting her 
ease into races at a relaxed pace while 
focusing on 'gathering fans.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her fame went up, media coverage would 
increase too. Shinko Windy found herself 
fired up.
